prompt: Who is the only female artist to have topped Spotify's list of most-streamed artists in three consecutive years (2020–2022)?
answer: No female artist did so. **Bad Bunny** topped Spotify’s most-streamed artists list for three consecutive years, **2020–2022**. The only female artist to top the list was **Taylor Swift**, in **2023 and 2024**.
